verdict.rationale: The official CLI documents a command to "run your Trigger.dev tasks locally", and a community user praises Dev mode for making testing and iterating smooth. However, nothing shows that this single command runs the whole engine locally rather than just the tasks. Nothing in the pack mentions a testing library, unit-test harness, time skipping or step mocking. missing for 10: evidence that one command runs the full engine locally, unit-testing utilities for workflows, time-skipping support, mocked-step support, independent corroboration of the testing story.
